---
title: "CDC Workshop on Safety Analysis for Autonomous Systems"
date: 2026-10-22
description: "ACRE Lab co-organizing a workshop at CDC 2026 on Safety Analysis for Autonomous Systems."
---

The ACRE Lab is helping to organize a workshop at the 2026 IEEE Conference on Decision and Control on "Safety Analysis for Autonomous Systems: Practical Perspectives and Recent Advances." More details can be found on the [accompanying website](https://haowwang.github.io/cdc26_safety_workshop/).
